title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 5. Supports the Council’s reduction of EUR 180 million under Article 06 04 01 — European Union Recovery Instrument (EURI) — Payment of periodic coupons and redemption at maturity; rejects the proposed approach whereby 65 % of the EURI’s cost overruns would be financed from the “decommitment” component of the EURI instrument; reiterates its opposition to the common borrowing mechanism underpinning NGEU and expresses concern about the growing burden that its financing costs place on the Union budget; emphasises that the financing of NGEU’s debt service costs should not reduce the budgetary resources available for key priorities such as agriculture, security, and border protection;
